correctness.rationale: The frozen proof does not justify its strict-base claim: 1+√3>3 is false. The replacement RESULT.md proves instead θ<3/4−(3/4)^3/3+(3/4)^5/5=3363/5120<2/3 by integrating the exact alternating decomposition of 1/(1+s²). Since √3>5/3, this gives 4θ<8/3<1+√3, keeping the original statement and parameter scope. Rechecked the repaired proof: shortest-path molecules reduce to edge roots; a product of two Hilbert–Schmidt operators yields the cyclic trace, with trace-square value 3. On x∈(0,1), λ f'(x)=−f(x−1) implies f''=−λ⁻²f; reflection and the endpoint equations give cos(1/λ)=4/5, sin(1/λ)=3/5 for even functions, sin(1/λ)=1 for odd ones. The converse identities at x=1 and the differentiated equation ensure no spurious roots, and both disjoint branches are simple. Signed powers are absolutely summable for m≥2. Cotangent subtraction gives the claimed generating function. The primary primal formula uses lattice-normalized volume, so divide by m! in the anchored basis; the square-summable subleading spectrum gives the relative asymptotic. A separate exact cube-order-simplex count gave m!W_m=24, 144, 1100, 10188, 110516 for m=3–7 (/workspace/branches/independent_checks.js). A separate recovered Ehrhart leading-coefficient check for m=3–6 agrees (direct_wheel_volume_check.py and multi_check.txt under /workspace/branches/a27ab2d7-6f37-481a-8c03-b9655717902f/). These checks are finite; the all-dimension result rests on the spectral proof. The uploaded verifier's reported checks were read, not rerun.
